candidate_contract.candidate_universe: all #132 complete-issue FULL N7 identities within each frozen threshold variant
candidate_contract.insufficient_k: explicit NO_BET_K_UNSATISFIED; no borrowing or cap relaxation
candidate_contract.rank_scope: within variant × complete issue; no source segment is a selection unit
candidate_contract.stake: K × 2187 FULL tickets × ¥2; identical across arms

chronology.history_rule: for target year y, history query is season_year < y; no target-year result is read or used
chronology.same_issue: all frozen identities for an issue remain intact; selection is issue-level

feature_contract.combined: within-issue percentile score = 0.50 market + 0.25 fundamental + 0.25 decision
feature_contract.fundamental: past-only Elo, rolling points/goal-difference, rank differential, rest and history-depth confidence; fixed constants, no target-year outcomes
feature_contract.missing_data: missing team IDs/history yields neutral fundamental probabilities and retained explicit missingness; no silent drop

output_boundary: No target result, score, final SP, winning SP, payout, tax, ROI, settlement, or post-kickoff field is selected or emitted. Gate B is unauthorized pending PI review.
scope: historical paper research only; no purchase, production, betting or promotion authority

upstream.identity_scope: #132 complete-issue matched FULL N7 identities; no candidate search or allocation rewrite
